definition: [ עָגַן ] verb Niph`al shut oneself in or off (Late Hebrew id. , Passive participle restrained (especially from marriage), also עוֺגִין anchor ; ᵑ7 עֲגַן be imprisoned ); — Imperfect 2 feminine plural תֵּעָגֵ֫נָה לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֺת לְאִישׁ Ruth 1:13 would ye shut yourselves off, so as not to belong to a man ?
